items.title: Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) and Sport Open Now Available at $299 and $199
items.summary: Bose has put its second-generation Ultra Open Earbuds and the new Sport Open Earbuds on sale. The flagship open-ear model adds a redesigned driver with deeper bass, Cinema Mode with TrueSpatial processing, and up to 9 hours of battery life, while the Sport variant targets workouts with an IP54 cuff design.

items.title: Apple AirPods Pro 3 Review: Heart-Rate Sensing and Live Translation Headline the Upgrade
items.summary: Reviewers rate the AirPods Pro 3 highly for best-in-class in-ear ANC, a new optical heart-rate sensor for workouts, and Apple Intelligence-powered Live Translation across five languages. Battery rises to 8 hours with ANC on and the earbuds carry an IP57 rating.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: A New Benchmark for Noise-Cancelling Earbuds
items.summary: The WF-1000XM6 earns top marks as Sony's best true-wireless flagship, with class-leading ANC, an upgraded eight-microphone call system, LDAC support and refined tuning. The main trade-offs are an $329.99 price and a tall, less pocketable charging case.

items.title: Fairphone Fairbuds 2 Launch: Modular, Repairable TWS Earbuds with LDAC
items.summary: Fairphone's Fairbuds 2 bring a tool-free modular design with seven user-replaceable parts, including earbud and case batteries, plus LDAC hi-res audio and 45dB ANC. Priced at 119 euros with a three-year warranty, they are billed as the world's first earbuds with a 100% PFAS-free exterior.

items.title: Noise Master Buds Open Pre-Booking in India with Sound by Bose Tuning
items.summary: Indian brand Noise has opened pre-bookings for its first clip-on open-ear earbuds, the Master Buds Open, tuned with Sound by Bose and a 10.8mm driver. The C-bridge design offers 4-mic ENC, 360-degree spatial audio, Bluetooth 5.4 and up to 28 hours of battery, launching October 23 at 7,999 rupees.

items.title: CMF Buds Pro 2 Review: 50dB ANC, LDAC and a Smart Dial at Budget Pricing
items.summary: Nothing's sub-brand packs the Buds Pro 2 with 50dB adaptive hybrid ANC, an 11mm plus 6mm dual-driver setup with LDAC, 43 hours of total battery and a rotating Smart Dial on the case. Reviewers praise the feature set for the price while noting the ANC trails flagship Bose and Sony models.

items.title: Shokz OpenFit Pro Hands-On: The Brand's First Open-Ear Earbuds with Noise Cancelling
items.summary: Shokz moves upmarket with the OpenFit Pro, its first open-ear earbuds to add active noise cancellation, pairing an ear-hook design with physical water-resistant buttons and wireless charging. The hands-on notes surprisingly fuller sound from the open design while keeping the brand's signature all-day comfort.

items.title: Anker's THUS AI Chip Brings On-Device Transcription and Smarter ANC to Soundcore Earbuds
items.summary: Anker unveiled seven Soundcore products at IFA 2026 built around its proprietary THUS AI chip, handling adaptive ANC, voice processing and on-device call or meeting transcription. Headliners include the Space 2 Pro headphones, the AeroClip 2 Pro open-ear clip with AI recording, and the Liberty Buds 2 with Comfort ANC.

items.title: Omdia: Global TWS Shipments Slip for First Time Since 2023 as Open-Ear Grows 12%
items.summary: Omdia's Q2 2026 tracker shows true wireless stereo shipments down 0.7% to 82.1 million units, the category's first annual decline since 2023, while open wireless stereo grew 12% to 11.1 million. Apple held the top spot with 20.5% share, and Omdia forecasts OWS to nearly double to 90.5 million by 2030.

items.title: Shokz October Prime Day Guide Spotlights OpenDots 2, OpenDots Air and OpenFit Air 2
items.summary: Shokz outlines its current open-ear lineup for the October Prime Day sales, including the clip-on OpenDots 2 with Dolby Audio and 40-hour total battery, the lightweight OpenDots Air, and the OpenFit Air 2 ear-hook earbuds with Bluetooth 6.1 and 36-hour battery. The guide helps buyers choose by design and use case.
